payload.title: Before the Last Ferry
payload.summary: Player-only prologue: a stagehand has moved a loose loading board over the gangway gap. Your character has not seen the board yet. The ferry will depart at 20:00; that departure is fixed. You can still determine who crosses safely and what they take with them.

quality.question: How can the character establish the gangway risk and protect the departure within a fixed sailing?

motives.label: Protect people affected by the case

questions.text: Your character can ask for a gangway check without claiming to know the hidden board. Which request establishes the risk in the world?
The crew can secure the board before departure. You have time to help one passenger properly: carry Nella’s instrument or arrange a final conversation for the departing witness.
Nella’s case has a marked handle and a fragile string bridge. Choose the supported carrying method.
The witness asks to speak privately to Ada, not to make a public confession. Which arrangement respects the stated request?
The board is secured and the ferry leaves at the stated time. The departure was fixed; the care, possessions and conversation carried into it were not.
